title: "Herbaria"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
source("R/map.R")
melanobs_map(show = "herbaria")
h <- read_herbaria()
knitr::kable(data.frame(paste0("[", h$name, "](herbaria/", h$slug, ".qmd)"),
                        h$code, h$city, h$country),
             col.names = c("Herbarium", "Code", "City", "Country"))
```
